gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-trirong: Trirong sets a bookish, dignified tone with softly varied strokes and gently flared curve ends. Cherry Swash is the louder one, a pencil-drawn display line that never presses harder, while Trirong holds the middle ground between monoline and sharp contrast.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-trocchi: Trocchi reads as a dignified classic serif, its wide ring of a c and bowls that thin gently without turning sharp. Against Cherry Swash's flat, single-weight linework, that mild thick and thin is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-trykker: Trykker reads literary and refined, with open counters that breathe and only a faint thick-thin contrast. Trykker thins just slightly against Cherry Swash, whose single-weight line looks like a plotter pen drew it, so the heading carries the swagger and the text stays hushed.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-uchen: Stately and a little carved. Cherry Swash holds a unit-width stroke throughout, while Uchen, a text serif with the slight heft change of a stone inscription, welcomes the eye into its lowercase curves.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-vollkorn-sc: Vollkorn SC reads literary and dignified, its terminals cut short of the bowl and its tracking loose as slack rope. Make Cherry Swash small, though, and its steady, unvarying line loses the commanding presence that stems outweighing hairlines only a little give this text serif.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-yuji-syuku: Authoritative describes this serif, Yuji Syuku, with open spacing and weight that shifts only slightly, like stretched rubber cord. Cherry Swash has no thin hairline anywhere, so the fuller stems and slimmer links below feel softer by comparison.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-ibm-plex-serif: IBM Plex Serif reads corporate and authoritative, with slimmer horizontals and an unclenched c. Cherry Swash matches its curves to its stems exactly, so a heading well above the body size lets that wide horseshoe c stand apart from the gentler modulation underneath.
gen-gf-chilanka-archivo: Chilanka's hand-drawn, uniform-thickness strokes keep every counter connected to the outside, graceful and relaxed. Archivo steps in with a commanding x-height and curves that open outward, doing the sturdy editorial work while Chilanka sets a moderate, loose mood.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-asap: Chilanka looks hand-drawn, its strokes the same width throughout and its counters left open to the outside space. Asap, a readable sans with a body height nearly matching its capitals, does the steadier work.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-bespoke-serif: Chilanka keeps one uninterrupted line width on every letter. Bespoke Serif, an authoritative classic serif whose thin strokes run about half the weight of its thick ones, tugs against that with heavier verticals and lighter horizontals, and the loose hand above makes it feel sharper.
